behaviours.name: Unholy Endurance (Carve damage)
behaviours.quote: Increases the damage and threat generated from Carve by $s1%.
behaviours.observe_source: Hit size: both arms carry attack power +20000 (fixture, a named precondition, the same in control and treatment). Carve's strike is 20% weapon damage (AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:166-175) and the weapon roll includes the normalized attack power term, so a hit is about 890 points in the control arm and 1023 with the passive (measured hit sizes of the counted pair): each of the two integer truncations of SpellEffects.cpp:4743 and Unit.cpp:11670 loses under 1 point, so under 0.12% of a hit each and under 0.25% together, inside the band of 2 points; at ~30-point hits the same truncations cost about 3 points of the 15 (the first proves read +11.1% and +12.3% from that truncation, not from the server). $s1 = 15 (300466 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectBasePoints 14 + EffectDieSides 1, MiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE; Spell.dbc read with apps/coa-dbc/inspect_dbc.py), class mask 0x80 of family 20 widened by AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:29-33 to 0x80/0/0x200000. Carve's strike 803715 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 0x80, weapon percent damage) is cast at the dummy trials times without the passive (control) and with it learned by a real learn (treatment), non-critical hits only; mean damage per hit must rise by 15 percent (band 13..17, G-19). The control arm is the same cast without 300466. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 300466: 0 events in 186 logs (passive, never logged); coa-history spell 803715 (Carve hit): SPELL_DAMAGE 1086 events in 5 logs, 188 crits, min 37 max 1630 mean 307 (gear and channel length differ, no figure decides); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22): Unholy Endurance 300466, Tyrant specialization, 'Increases the damage and threat generated from Carve by 15%.', same figure as the tooltip; nothing else found.

behaviours.observe_source: 300468 Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell 300469, Effect[1] aura 42 EffectTriggerSpell 524635 (Illidari Exhaustion, DurationIndex 18 = 20000 ms, the server casts both only when 524635 is absent, AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:256-259). 300469 Effect[0] aura 69 SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB, MiscValue 127, EffectBasePoints 199 (+1 = 200), EffectRealPointsPerLevel 8, BaseLevel 44, DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms ($300469d), target TARGET_SRC_CASTER / TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ALLY with radius index 18 = 15 yd ($300469a); the data row {300469, effect 0, ap 0.08, sp 0.2, stamina 1.0} adds 0.08 x attack power + 0.2 x max(Fire, Shadow spell power) + 1.0 x Stamina (AscensionFelswornData.h:13, AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:326-333). The absorb is 200 + 8 x (60 - 44) = 328 plus the three terms, read on the caster at each arm start (Stamina stat 2, spell power of Fire, attack power) and computed in float then truncated, as the Templar Staffguard 705295 entry does. 300469 is cast directly at the caster (a precondition: the trigger path from Hateforged Barrier is the shield_duration and ally_shield entries, and Hateforged Barrier's own absorb 705129 would add a random 177-208 + Stamina term to the read). Control arm: the same strike 41394 (Holy, 1100 damage) without the shield absorbs nothing; the stamina arm adds Stamina +12 (9119, MOD_STAT Stamina BasePoints 11 + 1) and the spell_power arm spell power +60 (17628, ASCENSION_MOD_SPELL_POWER_FLAT 59 + 1), so each term is proven by its own contrast. The attack power arm adds Trueshot Aura 31519 (Effect[0] aura 99 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER, EffectBasePoints 299 + 1 = +300) for the 0.08 term; the attack power is read at the arm start. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 300468 and 300469: 0 events in 186 logs (passive and its absorb were never logged); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22): Illidari Barrier 300468 'Casting Hateforged Barrier now also creates a damage absorption shield on all nearby allies within 15 yds, absorbing 328 + 100% Stamina + 20% SP + 8% AP damage for 5 seconds.', the same figures as the tooltip (328 = 200 + 8 x 16 levels, as computed here); nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Fel Haze (all enemy armor ignored under Blood of Mannoroth)
behaviours.quote: While active, Blood of Mannoroth now also causes you to ignore all enemy Armor.
behaviours.expected_source: 803903 Effect[0] aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) EffectBasePoints 99 (+100) on Blood of Mannoroth 802075 (class mask 0x200000 of family 20, SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2097152), whose Effect[0] is aura 280 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT with EffectBasePoints -1 (0%) in the DBC, moved by the Felsworn contract to aura 338 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_IGNORE_ARMOR_PCT (Felsworn ADR 0008, owner ruling O-13), so the stock armor penetration cap (at most (armor + K) / 3, ratio 1.5) does not apply: with the passive 100% of the armor is ignored. Carve's strike 803715 (physical weapon damage) is cast at the dummy in two arms, each hit non-critical. Increase Damage 37643 (Effect[0] aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, MiscValue 127, a stock single-effect self aura) is set on the caster in both arms with its effect 0 amount changed to 19900 (x200, a fixture size, not a claimed value) so each hit is large (about 3000 before armor) and the engine's ceil on the armored control hit adds less than 0.1%; without it a 14-16 hit rounds to 7-8 and the ratio reads about 1.95 (Felsworn ADR 0008). Lesser Armor 673 (Effect[0] aura 22 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE) is set on the dummy with its effect 0 amount changed to 5000 in both arms (a fixture size, not a claimed value) so the dummy armor reads 5528 (528 pinned reference armor plus 5000), as the Sun Cleric Vindicator 707773 ignores_armor entry. Classic combat armor mitigation at caster level 60: damage kept = K / (armor + K), K = 85 x 60 + 400 = 5500 (Unit.cpp ClassicPlusCombat::ArmorConstant). Control arm: Blood of Mannoroth 802075 set on the caster (a precondition fixture by harness set_aura, the condition of the clause, not its subject) with 803903 not learned: the full armor applies; treatment arm: 803903 learned, the same Blood: nothing is mitigated, so the mean hit ratio is (5528 + 5500) / 5500 = 2.0051 (+100.5%); band the larger of 5% of +100% and 2 points (95% to 105%), and a server ignoring 90% of the armor (ratio 1.822) or 50% (1.50) lies outside it. The expected value comes from the DBC amount and the armor formula, never from a run. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 803903: 0 events in 186 logs (passive, never logged); spell 802075 Blood of Mannoroth: SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS 33 events in 10 logs (a positive control that the active is logged; no armor figure); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22): Fel Haze 803903 'While active, Blood of Mannoroth now also causes you to ignore all enemy Armor.', same wording as the tooltip; nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Fel Haze (no armor left to ignore: zero-armor control)
behaviours.quote: While active, Blood of Mannoroth now also causes you to ignore all enemy Armor.
behaviours.expected_source: Zero-armor arm of the 803903 ignores_armor entry (Felsworn ADR 0008, owner ruling O-13): the same Carve strike 803715, the same Blood of Mannoroth 802075 precondition fixture in both arms and 803903 learned in the treatment arm only, with Lesser Armor 673 effect 0 set to -528 on the dummy (a fixture size, not a claimed value) so the dummy armor reads 0 (528 pinned reference armor minus 528). behaviours.name: Malice of Gul'dan (Felstrike stacks cap at 3)
behaviours.quote: stacking $u times.
behaviours.observe_source: Felstrike 802678 StackAmount 3 ($u of the Felstrike description that Malice of Gul'dan 800214 includes through @s:802678:0@), DurationIndex 32 = 6000 ms (SpellDuration.dbc row 32). The Malice handler (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:97-98, :227-229) casts 802678 on the target after an outgoing direct (not periodic) critical damage event that passes Chance() on the raw ProcChance 60 (AscensionFelsworn.cpp:231-239), which no spell modifier forces; a stack or refresh of the same caster's 802678 goes through ModStackAmount then OnAuraApply (Unit.cpp:5465-5466). Feed: Azzinoth's Assault 803475 (the level 60 rank, GCD 1000 ms, needs 803468 and 2 Felfury per cast) at the dummy every 1100 ms; its two strikes 520262 and 572585 (melee, not Derived, AscensionFelsworn.cpp:61-69) are direct hits, made critical by the melee crit rating fixture; the class file's hit and expertise ratings remove misses, dodges and parries. Fixtures named as preconditions: Felfury 800058 x6 and 803468 set before the casts and Felfury set to 6 again after every feed cast (refeed). Control: the same five casts before 800214 is learned read 0 stacks. Treatment: 6 trials of five casts each (stack_feed), each valid with at least 4 counted applications whose poll spans stay under 6000 ms; a valid trial passes at exactly 3 stacks, never 4. Design arithmetic only (not the residual): 10 strikes at 60% leave fewer than 4 applications in 5.5% of trials if every strike crits and lands; measured: pair prove1 (build 100257c26805, 2026-11-23) v = 0/4 in both runs; pair fw-tgs2 prove (server c3bd6628a143, 2026-11-23) v = 0/4 and 1/4, so the larger v = 1/4 sizes N = 6: (1/4)^6 = 0.024%, at most 0.05%; 1.40 and 1.00, then 1.15 and 1.33 applications per feed cast in the valid trials (per cast, not per hit: the scenario reads no hit count). Reference search 2026-11-23 (fw-b1b): coa-history 802678 16516 periodic damage events, nothing for the stack count.

behaviours.name: Reckoning (stacks cap at 4)
behaviours.quote: stacking $524632u times.
behaviours.observe_source: 524632 StackAmount 4 ($524632u), DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms. The Felsworn cast hook (AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:330-333) casts 524632 on the caster for every damaging Fel Fireball 801312 while the caster has the Reckoning aura 802058 (DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms). Five Fel Fireball casts at the dummy 2000 ms apart (a 1500 ms cast without Reckoning, the class file's spell hit rating): before (control) no Reckoning aura and 0 stacks; after, a real cast of Reckoning 802058 at the caster at the start of the phase (after_gate_cast; CastingTimeIndex 1 and StartRecoveryTime 0, so the Fel Fireballs that follow meet no global cooldown, and under Reckoning they are instant), its aura read present right after the cast (after_start_reads, else unmeasured) and any refused cast unmeasured (void_on_cast_failure); the learn of 802058 alone applies nothing. The phases are 2000 ms apart (expire_ms) so the before phase's last 1500 ms Fel Fireball has finished: at 500 ms the pair fw-tgs2 prove refused the Reckoning cast and the next Fel Fireball with SPELL_FAILED_SPELL_IN_PROGRESS (105), unmeasured in both runs. The five hits within its 10000 ms give 5 applications against a cap of 4: the stacks read 4 and not 5.

behaviours.observe_source: Contrast arm of drain_base: after a real learn of 500067 the Stamina reads 94.8, so the burn is 188 (2 x the integer Stamina 94, within 1.0; Unit.h:1061 GetStat returns the integer UNIT_FIELD_STAT0 value, AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:340-341 multiplies it by 2.0). Code: AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:340-341 sets Effect[0] of Manaburn to 2.0 x the caster's Stamina (Spell.dbc Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_POWER_BURN with no base points). Scarlet Magi 1832 (a mana-using mage, so the burn lands) is the target; the caster's spell crit chance is removed by Reg's Test Aura 984954 (Effect[1] aura 57 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_CRIT_CHANCE, base -1001; Unit.cpp:10329-10355 reads the player's PLAYER_SPELL_CRIT_PERCENTAGE for a magic spell, StatSystem.cpp:1012-1013 sums aura 57 into it), so the magic hit cannot be critical and partial resists removed (823764) by harness set_aura, precondition fixtures; reference stat 2 (Stamina) = 79.0 from the class file. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 805248: 25 casts, 22 damage events (58 to 352, mean 193, 7 crits), 22 drains (58 to 591, mean 181), 2 misses in 4 logs (the players' Stamina is not recorded, so no figure decides); the bindmysoul snapshot and ~/CoaServer/reference repeat the tooltip; nothing found that states another value. The read follows the cast by 300 ms: the target's own mana regeneration added 17 in the 1500 ms window of the first pair G2 (reads -141 and -171 against 158 and 188 burnt by damage), so the window is shortened. The Stamina the player sees and the engine multiplies is the integer total: Fel Monstrosity 500067 makes it 79 x 1.2 = 94.8, shown as 94 (the exact-stat entry 500067 stamina reads 94.8; the integer is its floor), so the amount is 2 x 94 = 188. The entry casts once, after the learn (cast_in_before false), so the read window is one 300 ms window like drain_base: the first pair G3 cast twice and its second window gained 17 mana of regeneration (-171 read, 188 burnt by damage in the same cast).

behaviours.quote: While Inner Demon is active, your melee haste is now increased by $s2%
behaviours.observe_source: $s2 = 15 (805236 Effect[1], EffectBasePoints 14 + EffectDieSides 1); the aura 807426 the script applies while Inner Demon 804216 and 805236 are both on the caster carries aura 138 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_HASTE with BasePoints 14 + 1 = 15 (AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:81-92, AscensionFelsworn.cpp:274). The main-hand attack time is read 500 ms after a harmless Bless 804247 before (control: 805236 not learned) and after a real learn, with Inner Demon 804216 set on the caster in both phases by harness set_aura (a precondition fixture): the after time over the before time is 1/1.15 = 0.869565 within 0.001, so 14% and 16% are excluded. The Physical hit is reduced by the dummy's armor, the same fraction in both arms, so the ratio of two attack powers is judged: treatment arm with AP Test 56412 at 3 stacks (SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER, BasePoints 800 + 1 = +801 each, +2403, a named precondition fixture) has attack power 2715, so the expected ratio of the non-critical hit is (60 + 0.285 x 2715) / (60 + 0.285 x 312) = 833.8 / 148.9 = 5.6 (band 5.37..5.83, G-19). A wrong base value or coefficient moves the ratio (no attack power term: 1.0; no base: 8.7). Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 800204: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event; positive control 801904 Azzinoth's Assault: 21 casts); bindmysoul talents snapshot: nothing found; expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only.

behaviours.name: Felstrike (damage per tick, server formula)
behaviours.quote: Burn an enemy for ${($d*1000/$T1)*($m1+0+$SP*.05)} Shadowflame Damage over $d,
behaviours.observe_source: Spell.dbc 802678 (server set /srv/coa/server-data/dbc) Effect[0] aura 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE, EffectAmplitude 1000, DurationIndex 32 = 6000 ms (6 ticks), EffectBasePoints 8, EffectDieSides 1, EffectRealPointsPerLevel 0.5, BaseLevel 10, SpellLevel 10, MaxLevel 0. SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp:479) at level 60: 8 + 1 (DieSides 1 adds 1) + int(0.5 x (60 - max(BaseLevel 10, SpellLevel 10))) = 9 + 25 = 34 per tick; the SP term of the tooltip ($SP*.05) is 0 at the reference spell power 0 (class file reference_stats). The displayed ${($d*1000/$T1)*($m1+0+$SP*.05)} reads 54 = 6 x 9 on the client (ADR 0006: no SkillLineAbility row, base points only); owner ruling O-19: the server keeps 34 per tick and the displayed text is to be corrected, so the value is counted on the server formula (6 x 34 = 204 over the six ticks), not on the displayed 54. The server's effect value is read with spell_effect_value, which applies CalcValue with the spell mods (the same read as Magic Fiend 704613 stolen); the same value before and after the learn of Malice of Gul'dan 800214 is the control (a learn changes no amount). Reference search 2026-11-23: nothing found beyond the tooltip, Spell.dbc and the Felstrike tick events of coa-history (spell 802678, gear and level differ, no figure decides).
